html:
The Barada Barna, also called Baranha or Barna, are an Aboriginal people of central Queensland, in the hinterland west of Mackay around present day Nebo.

Their neighbours on the map include the Yilba to the north, the Wangan and Biri nearby and the Guwa further inland. Pastoral runs spread into the area in the early 1860s, and Native Police patrols followed. Much of their country now lies over the coal mines of the Bowen Basin. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
sum: The Barada Barna, also called Baranha or Barna, are an Aboriginal people of central Queensland, in the hinterland west of Mackay around present day Nebo.
